tasks.label: Smoke test distribution executable
tasks.command: Set-Location .\dist; $output = @('INVALID::RESOURCE', '..\captures', '0') | .\CaptureOnTrig.exe 2>&1; $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE; $output | ForEach-Object { Write-Output $_ }; $text = $output -join ' '; if ($exitCode -ne 0 -or $text -notmatch 'Enter the scope IP address' -or $text -notmatch 'Enter data path' -or $text -notmatch 'Enter trigger wait timeout' -or $text -notmatch 'VI_ERROR_INV_RSRC_NAME' -or $text -match 'Traceback|lost sys.stdin') { throw 'Distribution smoke test failed' }; Write-Output 'PASS: startup prompts and bundled VISA backend work; deliberately invalid resource rejected as expected.'
